name: 3S Chat
author: Joakim
description: Captures all chat channels and tells into a Chats capture pane, with name watching (notify + beep). 1.1.0: the pane is yours to shape - a Chat panel lists every channel that has spoken; click a channel to pick it, then a colour in the column beside it to paint it (sixteen named colours, the theme tokens, or default); each channel line carries its own hide/show link (hidden = out of the pane, still logged, a notify subscription still fires); 'chat channels', 'chat show|hide <channel>', 'chat color <channel> <name|#hex|->' do the same by command. Both persist.
